title: Volley Claude Account Usage
description: A supervisor's retained per-account fold of its agents' usage samples, published to volley/_system/claude-accounts/<acct>. The rate-limit windows belong to the account, not the agent, so the newest sample wins. See spec section 4.6.12.

plan.description: The plan label Claude Code reported at sign-in (registry accounts only).

five_hour.description: The 5-hour window from the newest sample that carried one; null when none has.

weekly.description: The weekly window from the newest sample that carried one; null when none has.

agents.description: Agents whose latest sample is on this account.

sampled_at.description: captured_at of the newest sample folded in.

sampled_by.description: The agent that published that sample.
